title: Quiet Caption Over The Lake
tests: Tests exact caption rendering, readable placement, and preservation of the supplied photograph.

faults.what: The caption is oversized and split across two lines in the lower-middle of the photo rather than placed near the bottom.
An unrequested large translucent black rectangle covers much of the lake and some of the mountains, making the overlay substantially more intrusive than a simple white caption.

judge.summary: The wording is correct and the full photo is preserved, but oversized text and a large dark panel overwhelm the scene instead of providing a clean bottom caption.

must_haves.item: The caption reads exactly 'A little room to breathe', without quotation marks.
must_haves.why: All words are correct, with no quotation marks.

must_haves.item: The caption is white, readable, and placed near the bottom with no clipped letters.
must_haves.why: The letters are white, readable, and unclipped, but the caption occupies the lower-middle rather than sitting near the bottom.

must_haves.item: The supplied mountain lake, pine trees, and sky remain recognizable and retain the original full framing.
must_haves.why: The original wide framing and recognizable landscape remain intact, although the panel darkens a substantial area.

must_haves.item: The caption appears as a graphic overlay, not as a physical object in the scene.
must_haves.why: The text and translucent backing are clearly graphic overlays.
